observations: Both application RTCs mask IRQ49/50 while retaining RAW_INTR1.
Posted EOI leaves RAW_INTR1 immediately before/after ISR write; subsequent observation finds0. Immediate return caused repeated ISR entry up to8 safety cap.

ISR disables local delivery then posts EOI. Bounded main-context32us polling re-enables only after raw0 and local pending clear. Each channel delivers4 expected events: masked one-shot, two periodic, rearmed one-shot.
120ms against TIMER1 nominal32MHz gives approximately3850 ticks versus QEMU32000Hz3840. Nominal32k profile is consistent,32768Hz is outside accepted3800..3900 interval.
limits: 32us model ACK delay is an explicit regression assumption, not a measured synchronization latency.
No precise frequency calibration, external crystal/source identification, stopped-clock EOI or fast expiry/ACK collision proof.
Main service loop has finite observation budget; this example does not guarantee lossless high-rate notification.
Control core held reset; production handoff, low-power wake and shared common RTC bank remain unqualified.
SDK source helper writes EOI1 despite a header read-clear comment; no EOI read behavior tested.
